items.question: What makes this form beneficial for the world during the mighty Kali age?
premises: The Kali age is characterized as mighty and intense.
This specific form is declared beneficial for the world.
The preceding context emphasizes special efficacy in the Kali age.
items.inference: Therefore this form is especially suited and beneficial for beings in the mighty Kali age.
uncertainties: prabale is taken as qualifying kali+kāle, though it could be read more generally.
items.plain_english: In the mighty Kali age, indeed, this form is beneficial for the world.
